annotation.title_clean: 国务院关于印发“十四五”现代综合交通运输体系发展规划的通知
annotation.title_en: State Council Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of a Modern Comprehensive Transport System
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
annotation.venue: 中国政府网 / 国发〔2021〕27号
annotation.summary_en: China's State Council 14th Five-Year Plan for a modern comprehensive transport system (2021). Mostly infrastructure, green transition and safety; includes limited provisions on intelligent transport, such as supporting autonomous driving pilots in restricted areas, an autonomous driving oversight platform, drone and unmanned vehicle delivery, autonomous ship navigation, and data security standards.
key_provisions_or_claims: Cautiously develop autonomous driving and vehicle-road coordination, encouraging testing in ports and logistics parks
Build autonomous driving oversight platform and a comprehensive UAV regulatory service platform
Promote unmanned vehicle and drone delivery and autonomous ship navigation technologies
Develop intelligent transport data security standards and classified data protection
Targets for 2025 on intelligence, green transport and safety indicators
